breakdown.description: The sinusoidal traction is moved from the specified global x-coordinate to a local edge coordinate
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states that the sinusoidal traction uses 'the global x-coordinate of the point on the hypotenuse' (i.e., -5e3 * sin(π * x) where x is global), directly contradicting the flawed instruction to use a local arclength coordinate. This matches the ground truth's requirement to evaluate the traction variation with the global coordinate named in the load definition.
